ev.q: This report describes a case of human rabies caused by a Mexican free-tailed bat virus variant occurring in Glenn County, California, in 2002.
During 1990--2000, a total of 24 (75%) of 32 human rabies cases were attributed to variants of rabies virus associated with bats
Four household members, two other family members, and 12 social contacts received postexposure prophylaxis (PEP)

This report summarizes the investigation by the Glenn County Health Department (GCHD) and the California Department of Health Services (CDHS).
